task: Find the most download machine translation model on Huggingface which focuses on English and Japanese (en-ja) and report the evaluation metrics stated for it.
answer: The most downloaded machine translation model on Hugging Face focused on English and Japanese (en-ja) is facebook/nllb-200-distilled-600M (found by filtering Models by Translation task, English + Japanese languages, and sorting by Most Downloads; ~889k downloads).
